source: Two user-supplied Coinwise/K1m6a screenshots, read visually; not an independently verified live feed

observed.price_path_visual: Substantial rally followed by a pullback to dVAH; the latest displayed price is slightly below dVAH, not a confirmed hold above it.
observed.cvd_path_visual: Rose through the visible rally and declined on the last few bars.
observed.oi_path_visual: Recovered during the visible advance, then declined from a local peak to 18.3B.
observed.liquidations_path_visual: A conspicuous earlier negative short-liquidation bar precedes the latest positive long-liquidation bar. The earlier bar's exact amount is not readable and is not inferred.

data_quality.comparison_note: Do not subtract an earlier session's CVD reading from this one without verifying the same feed, instrument, settings, accumulation anchor and timestamps. Use the visible within-chart path here.
data_quality.oi_note: Aggregate OI does not identify which side initiated positions or their leverage multiples. USD-denominated OI may also change with valuation. Net OI decline does not rule out simultaneous new openings.
data_quality.liquidation_note: Right-edge values are displayed readings for an unspecified interval, not established session totals; minus sign is display direction, not negative economic liquidations.

assessment.interpretation: The visible advance was accompanied by improving CVD and included short-liquidation activity. The latest pullback, declining OI and long-liquidation reading are consistent with some position reduction or long liquidation, but do not establish a safe dip or identify the only cause. The dVAH retest remains unresolved.
assessment.probability_note: Earlier conversational percentages such as 60-70% were not calibrated on an out-of-sample sample and must not be used as measured probabilities or risk-sizing inputs.

long_candidate.trigger: Reclaim and hold the current chart's 78871 area (approximately 78870-78900), then a successful retest and a higher local low while CVD stabilizes or improves.
long_candidate.invalidation: A failed retest and break of the new local retest low cancels this specific entry setup regardless of whether OI is rising or falling.
long_candidate.execution_gate: No executable MEXC limit or stop derived from this reference chart without matching symbol, fresh execution quotes and risk parameters.

failed_reclaim.trigger: Price stays below 78871 and a bounce into it fails, with renewed selling pressure.
failed_reclaim.action: No blind averaging. A short is only a separate failed-reclaim candidate with defined invalidation and adequate reward relative to risk, not an instruction to chase the low.

risk_and_case_handling.position_state: UNKNOWN_CURRENT: screenshots do not show current owner fills, remaining quantity, average, liquidation level or stop
risk_and_case_handling.case_registry_state: Preserved; no closure or new position inferred
risk_and_case_handling.guidance: Do not increase size to recover prior lost profit. Protect existing gains with a preplanned stop and profit-taking plan; do not widen a stop to the distant old dVAL to preserve a failed entry thesis.

learning_summary: A rally working out does not prove the prior entry suggestion had a statistically demonstrated edge.
Separate the whole rally from the most recent pullback; their OI/CVD directions can differ.
Price being 13.58 below dVAH is a test, not proof of decisive breakdown or acceptance above it.
Price invalidation is sufficient to cancel an entry; do not wait for a particular OI pattern to honor a stop.
Hypotheses, observations, fills and realized results must be separate fields.
